newsitem.title: NORWAY: Dyno sees lower results in 2nd half.
newsitem.headline: Dyno sees lower results in 2nd half.

text.p: Norwegian explosives and chemicals company Dyno Industrier ASA said on Monday it did not expect results in the third and fourth quarters of 1997 to be on the same level as in the second quarter.
The company said the second quarter had shown normal seasonally higher activity.
It added that it did not expect any major changes in the group's markets in the second half of the year.
Dyno beat market expectations on Monday and booked pre-tax profits for the first six months 1997 of 262 million crowns and an operating result of 300 million crowns.
A Reuters poll of seven analysts forecast an operating result of 254 million crowns and pre-tax profits of 218 million crowns.
